description: The independent price-comparison sites this server searches (furniture and lighting, tools, toys, LEGO, board games, games, baby, pets, perfume, books, smart home and more): key, name, what each covers, its markets and languages, its home page and its own MCP server for deeper questions (categories, brands, guides, toplists).

locale.description: Language and market (nl-NL = Dutch for the Netherlands, fr-BE = French for Belgium, de-DE = German for Germany, en-NL = English for the Netherlands; FR, DK and SE too). Shops, prices, currency and stock are per market; only sites that serve the locale answer. Default nl-NL.
